Class GermanTaxKeys

java.lang.Object
grafioschtrader.reportviews.germantax.GermanTaxKeys
public final class GermanTaxKeys extends Object
The names of the blocks, categories, lines, detail kinds, warnings and reasons of the German tax report. The client translates a block with the prefix GERMAN_TAX_BLOCK_, a category with GERMAN_TAX_CATEGORY_, a line with GERMAN_TAX_LINE_, a warning with GERMAN_TAX_WARN_ and a reason with GERMAN_TAX_REASON_.
